This chapter walks through a day: **to wake up** (صحى — se7i), **to sleep** (نام — nam), the meals in between, and how to put a time on all of it. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## To wake up — صحى — se7i

Final-weak verb. Future: ها + stem (*ana has7a*); past: *ana se7eet, huwwa se7i*.

| Pronoun | Present |
|---|---|
| أنا - ana | بصحى - bas7a |
| إنت - inta | بتصحى - bits7a |
| إنتِ - inti | بتصحي - bits7i |
| هو - huwwa | بيصحى - biys7a |
| هي - hiyya | بتصحى - bits7a |
| إحنا - e7na | بنصحى - bins7a |
| إنتو - intu | بتصحوا - bits7u |
| هم - humma | بيصحوا - biys7u |

## To sleep — نام — nam

Hollow verb (like راح). Future: ها + stem (*ana hanam*); past: *ana nemt, huwwa nam*.

| Pronoun | Present |
|---|---|
| أنا - ana | بنام - banam |
| إنت - inta | بتنام - bitnam |
| إنتِ - inti | بتنامي - bitnami |
| هو - huwwa | بينام - biynam |
| هي - hiyya | بتنام - bitnam |
| إحنا - e7na | بننام - binnam |
| إنتو - intu | بتناموا - bitnamu |
| هم - humma | بيناموا - biynamu |

## The meals

Each meal has its own verb. Here are the everyday "I" forms.

| Verb | I (أنا) - franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| فطر | بفطر - baftar | to have breakfast |
| اتغدى | بتغدى - bat8adda | to have lunch |
| اتعشى | بتعشى - bat3ashsha | to have dinner |

And the nouns:

| Arabic - franco | English |
|---|---|
| فطار - fetar | breakfast |
| غدا - 8ada | lunch |
| عشا - 3asha | dinner |

## Telling the time

Ask **الساعة كام؟ (el-sa3a kam?)** "what time is it?". Answer with **الساعة (el-sa3a)** + the hour. To say "at six", it's the same: *el-sa3a setta*.

| Arabic - franco | Hour |
|---|---|
| واحدة - wa7da | 1 |
| اتنين - etneen | 2 |
| تلاتة - talata | 3 |
| أربعة - arba3a | 4 |
| خمسة - 5amsa | 5 |
| ستة - setta | 6 |
| سبعة - sab3a | 7 |
| تمانية - tamanya | 8 |
| تسعة - tes3a | 9 |
| عشرة - 3ashara | 10 |
| حداشر - 7edashar | 11 |
| اتناشر - etnashar | 12 |

For the parts of the hour: **و نص (w noss)** "half past", **و ربع (w rob3)** "quarter past", **إلا ربع (ella rob3)** "quarter to". So *el-sa3a setta w noss* = "half past six".

## Examples

<details class="frase">
<summary>بصحى الساعة ستة</summary>
<span class="fr">bas7a el-sa3a setta</span>
<span class="en">I wake up at six</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>بفطر الساعة سبعة</summary>
<span class="fr">baftar el-sa3a sab3a</span>
<span class="en">I have breakfast at seven</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>بتغدى الساعة تلاتة</summary>
<span class="fr">bat8adda el-sa3a talata</span>
<span class="en">I have lunch at three</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>بنام الساعة عشرة ونص</summary>
<span class="fr">banam el-sa3a 3ashara w noss</span>
<span class="en">I go to sleep at half past ten</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>بصحى بدري كل يوم</summary>
<span class="fr">bas7a badri kol yom</span>
<span class="en">I wake up early every day</span>
</details>

## Dialogue: a day's schedule

Mostafa asks Hind about her routine.

<span class="rotulo">مصطفى — Mostafa</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بتصحى الساعة كام؟</summary>
<span class="fr">bits7a el-sa3a kam?</span>
<span class="en">What time do you wake up?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هند — Hind</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بصحى الساعة ستة</summary>
<span class="fr">bas7a el-sa3a setta</span>
<span class="en">I wake up at six</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">مصطفى — Mostafa</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>وبتفطري إمتى؟</summary>
<span class="fr">we bitiftari emta?</span>
<span class="en">And when do you have breakfast?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هند — Hind</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>بفطر الساعة سبعة، وبروح الشغل</summary>
<span class="fr">baftar el-sa3a sab3a, we baroo7 el-sho8l</span>
<span class="en">I have breakfast at seven and go to work</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">مصطفى — Mostafa</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>وبتنامي بدري؟</summary>
<span class="fr">we bitnami badri?</span>
<span class="en">And do you sleep early?</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">هند — Hind</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>لأ، بنام الساعة اتناشر</summary>
<span class="fr">la2, banam el-sa3a etnashar</span>
<span class="en">No, I sleep at twelve</span>
</details>
